status: New integration candidate delivered; not final user-approved production art.

current_runtime.limitation: Full-body sprites have horizontal weapons baked in. They cannot represent up/down aim by adding a separate gun.

latest_modular.approval: User approved the approach and mockup work, not production use of these corrected poses. Revision 3 still awaits approval.
limitations: Standing only; no downward, jump or fall body frames.
Rear shoulder connections rely on occlusion.
Grip silhouettes and pixel density need production review.
No validated locomotion, recoil or landing transition set.

existing_art_reuse_contract.scope: Permits technical prototyping with existing sources; does not confer visual approval or fill missing directions.
existing_art_reuse_contract.layers: Use manifest source rectangles and transforms; keep arms at fixed body-relative scale. Do not stretch toward a target grip.
existing_art_reuse_contract.state: Choose aim pose from persistent permitted aim direction, independently of whether a shot is fired. Fire timer controls recoil/effects only.
existing_art_reuse_contract.mirroring: Reflect all layers and grip/muzzle anchors around the same registration x=64.
existing_art_reuse_contract.grounding: Apply existing weapon aiming permissions on landing before choosing the pose and muzzle. An airborne downward pose must not remain active on ground.
existing_art_reuse_contract.missing_direction: Do not rotate the entire hero or silently label horizontal sprites as directional. Missing art remains a visible unfinished limitation.
existing_art_reuse_contract.existing_horizontal: Original combined sheets remain the current runtime fallback; do not add a second weapon over them.

minimum_remaining_delivery: Weapon-free airborne bodies for both heroes with knees/feet clear of muzzle.
Authored down and down-right arms/hands and separate weapons with measured grip/muzzle positions; mirror down-left.
Validate standing up/up-right corrections and fixed limb scale.
Check persistent aim while idle/moving, airborne downward fire and landing fallback before promotion.
candidate_coverage: Both heroes: standing right/up-right/up and airborne right/up-right/up/down-right/down; mirror left variants. 16 holds total.
approval_clarification: No user instruction forbids further art creation or a technical integration candidate. Earlier approval-pending wording describes visual review, not a separate required permission to author assets.
remaining: Live transitions and silhouette review, locomotion/recoil cycles and final visual signoff.

runtime_integration.checks: Packaged held-aim pose selection, matching mirrored muzzles, fire release/cooldown, landing and obstruction checks pass.
runtime_integration.remaining: Live review/screenshots, locomotion/recoil animation and final pose refinement.
